prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high-fidelity 1600x1000 landscape desktop screenshot for WARCODE, a personal AI coding app. Real usable native application interface only, edge-to-edge, no laptop, no marketing page, no photographic frame. The visual direction is a familiar dark professional code editor executed with excellent typography and subtle flat depth: dark slate #191C22 canvas, #242933 raised areas, #E4E8EF text, desaturated blue #7CA8F8 primary controls. Inter or Geist typography with precise readable 13-15px interface text, IBM Plex Mono code, restrained 6px corners, 1px separators. Brand WARCODE top left with original angular W monogram. No OpenCode or original O icon.
Skeleton: thin native title bar with Warcode. 240px left project/session sidebar. Broad central conversation and fixed bottom prompt composer. 380px right code review panel. Bottom status bar. Sidebar has New session button, project CodingHarness and sessions Refine the workspace (selected), Fix auth callback, Add keyboard shortcuts, plus Settings at bottom. Central header Refine the workspace and branch warcode-rebrand. User message “Simplify the project sidebar and improve keyboard navigation.” Warcode response “I’ll update the sidebar structure, then check focus and keyboard navigation.” Compact activity row Edited sidebar.tsx. A readable TypeScript diff. Assistant closing text “The sidebar now groups sessions by project. Keyboard focus follows the visible order.” Composer placeholder “Ask Warcode to build something…” with Build and Claude Sonnet selectors, attachment icon, blue send button. Right side heading Changes, Files and Review tabs and sidebar.tsx code diff with subtle green additions and muted red deletions. Bottom Local workspace and All changes saved. No invented marketing metrics or customer claims. One consistent outline icon family. Clear software hierarchy and enough negative space for sustained coding, no gradients, glow, decorative diagrams or false terminal widgets.
